# Rob Watt Films

> Rob Watt is a filmmaker and aerial cinematographer who directs feature films as well as commercials for major brands. He is also the creator of the Getting Made Podcast. This site is his portfolio and journal.

Contact: rob@airwolfdrones.com
Services: directing for feature films and commercials, producing, consulting
Clients: Amblin Entertainment, Netflix, Hulu, Subaru, Boot Barn, HBO Max, Amazon MGM Studios, UFC, Google, CAA Sports, GoPro, LBI Entertainment

## Work

- [Home](https://robwattfilms.com/): landing page
- [Aerial](https://robwattfilms.com/html/aerial.html): aerial and drone cinematography for commercials, films and brands
  - [Boot Barn — Dallas](https://robwattfilms.com/html/aerial/boot-barn-dallas.html): Escape the city and Rodeo from above
  - [Beneath the Mountain — Vermont Danby Quarry](https://robwattfilms.com/html/aerial/beneath-the-mountain.html): Aerial cinematography for Beneath the Mountain, a short film inside the Danby marble quarry in Vermont.
  - [Boot Barn — USA 250](https://robwattfilms.com/html/aerial/boot-barn-usa-250.html): Aerial cinematography for Boot Barn's USA 250 campaign: a herd of horses galloping beneath mountain peaks.
  - [Boot Barn — Wheels Off](https://robwattfilms.com/html/aerial/boot-barn-wheels-off.html): Aerial cinematography for Boot Barn's Wheels Off spot: mud, monster trucks and a day off the pavement.
  - [Boot Barn — Westward, Marfa](https://robwattfilms.com/html/aerial/boot-barn-westward-marfa.html): Aerial cinematography for Boot Barn's Westward campaign, filmed in Marfa, Texas.
  - [Boot Barn — Higher Ground](https://robwattfilms.com/html/aerial/boot-barn-higher-ground.html): Aerial cinematography for Boot Barn's Higher Ground spot: a helicopter crew at work among high-voltage towers.
  - [Boot Barn — Trick Rider](https://robwattfilms.com/html/aerial/boot-barn-trick-rider.html): Aerial cinematography for Boot Barn: a trick rider at full gallop.
- [Films](https://robwattfilms.com/html/films.html): narrative and documentary films
